name: OMIM_search
description: Search OMIM database for Mendelian diseases and genes. OMIM is the authoritative source for human genetic disorders. Search by gene name, disease name, or phenotype keywords. Returns MIM numbers, titles, and entry types. Requires OMIM_API_KEY env var (register at omim.org/api).

query.description: Search query - gene name (BRCA1), disease (cystic fibrosis), or phenotype (intellectual disability)

start.description: The 0-based offset this page of search results starts at, e.g. 0. Needed with the total to page through the matches.

OMIM_API_KEY.purpose: Look up Mendelian disease–gene relationships and clinical variant records for interpretation.
OMIM_API_KEY.without: OMIM tools return no data without it. Free for academic use.

name: OMIM_get_entry
description: Get detailed OMIM entry by MIM number. Returns comprehensive information including text description, clinical features, inheritance, molecular genetics, and references. MIM numbers are 6-digit identifiers (e.g., 164730 for BRAF gene). Requires OMIM_API_KEY.

mim_number.description: OMIM MIM number (e.g., 164730, 219700). Can include OMIM: prefix.

geneMap.description: The gene's map position: {sequenceID, chromosome, chromosomeSymbol, chromosomeSort, chromosomeLocationStart, chromosomeLocationEnd, transcript, cytoLocation}. Present on gene entries; this is where the cytogenetic band and the coordinates live.

prefix.description: OMIM's entry-type prefix: '*' a gene, '#' a phenotype with a known molecular basis, '+' gene and phenotype, '%' a phenotype of unknown basis, and no prefix for other entries. Measured '#' on cystic fibrosis and '*' on BRAF. This single character decides how the whole entry should be read.

status.description: Record status, e.g. 'live'. A non-live entry has been moved or withdrawn.

name: OMIM_get_gene_map
description: Get OMIM gene-disease mapping information. Returns genes mapped to chromosomal locations with associated phenotypes and inheritance patterns. Query by MIM number or chromosome. Useful for finding all disease genes on a chromosome.

mim_number.description: OMIM MIM number for specific gene (optional if chromosome provided)

chromosome.description: Chromosome number (1-22, X, Y) to get all genes (optional if mim_number provided)

limit.description: Maximum results for chromosome query (default: 50, max: 100)

name: OMIM_get_clinical_synopsis
description: Get clinical synopsis (phenotype features) for an OMIM phenotype entry. Returns structured clinical features organized by body system (e.g., neurologic, cardiovascular). Essential for phenotype-based disease matching. Requires OMIM_API_KEY.

mim_number.description: OMIM MIM number for phenotype (e.g., 219700 for cystic fibrosis)

abdomenBiliaryTract.description: Biliary tract features, e.g. 'Biliary cirrhosis'. One of OMIM's body-system fields. The value is a SINGLE string, not a list: several features are separated by ';\n', and each carries its ontology codes inline in braces -- {SNOMEDCT:...}, {ICD10CM:...}, {UMLS ...}, {HP:...}. Parse the codes out of the braces rather than expecting separate fields. Which body-system fields appear depends entirely on the disease, so a missing one means the synopsis does not record that system, never that the system is normal.
